items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: How long did you take lessons from Mr. Cottrell?

ctx.x: Yeah, I played with all them bands, yeah. All in all, if you need to be sure to come get them. Yeah. But Marie would work in them nightclub, you know? Yeah. Played a regular nightclub with them regular jobs.
How long did you take lessons from Mr. Cottrell?

Not too long. Well, see, my first wife, she most enlightened me. Oh, she was the? She was a good musician, yeah. She was good. Them fellas tell you about it. She was a sight reader. She was wonderful.
